name: Introduction to Web Development
description: A comprehensive beginner course covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Build real projects from scratch and learn modern development workflows.

name: Advanced TypeScript Patterns
description: Deep dive into TypeScript's type system including generics, conditional types, template literals, and advanced inference. Prerequisites: TypeScript basics.

name: Database Design & PostgreSQL
description: Learn relational database design principles, normalization, indexing strategies, and advanced PostgreSQL features including CTEs, window functions, and JSONB.

name: React & Modern Frontend Architecture
description: Build production-grade React applications with hooks, context, suspense, and server components. Covers state management, testing, and performance optimization.

name: DevOps Fundamentals
description: CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and infrastructure as code with Terraform. Hands-on labs with real cloud environments.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Master fundamental data structures and algorithms with practical implementations in TypeScript. Includes arrays, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, and dynamic programming.
